units.source_text: 夏秋两季，我一直在庙里生活，几乎不与他人交谈。

en.t: Through the summer and autumn, I lived continuously in the temple and hardly spoke with anyone else.

units.source_text: 我出走的前一天早晨，老师命令副司把我唤去。

en.t: On the morning of the day before I ran away, the teacher ordered the assistant priest to summon me.
